name: Potatoes
description: A dependable kitchen staple. Give whole potatoes a dark, ventilated spot rather than a sunny countertop.

storage.label: Whole
storage.advice: Store away from light in a cool place; scrub before cooking.
storage.caution: A warm kitchen may shorten this estimate considerably.

buying: Avoid potatoes with extensive greening or decay.
freshness: Discard potatoes with extensive sprouting, shriveling, or deep greening. These changes can accompany increased glycoalkaloids; see the linked extension guidance.
leftovers: Use sound potatoes in a tray of roasted vegetables.
Turn cooked potatoes into a warm salad.
